purpose: Centred error placeholder with a disc, title, description, progress line, retry, secondary action and details disclosure for a failed load, or a neutral not-found state.
useWhen: Replacing a primary content region after its query or request failed, so the failure never looks like an empty result.
Offering the user a retry for a region that can be reloaded, with the retry as the only primary action on the page.
Telling a person that the thing they asked for doesn't exist, using the neutral tone.

avoidWhen.reason: Communicating that a region has no data — use empty-state instead.
Reporting the result of a just-completed action — use alert or toast-region.
